label: Peplink Balance 310 Fiber 5G
description: Branch SD-WAN router with a fibre WAN and 5G: 1x GE WAN, 5x GE LAN, 1 Gbps routing throughput.
notes: Vendor figures, extracted from the Peplink tech-spec PDF with the text layer read directly: **Number of Ethernet WAN port 1 (GE)**, **Number of Ethernet LAN port 5 (GE)**, **Router Throughput 1 Gbps**, SpeedFusion 600 Mbps unencrypted and 500 Mbps at 256-bit AES, and the sheet's own summary row reads **'1 WAN with 5 LAN'**. The 'Fiber' in the name refers to a fibre-capable WAN path, not to an SFP cage in the port list - the sheet lists GE copper. Requests #508 and #509 are the two 5G modem SKUs (BPL-310-FBR-5GD-TPRM and -5GN-T-PRM) over this same port layout.
